_comment: The tool build the ranked numbers (the sky130 A0' area and time, and with them par, the record and every board) are rated with: the README ("Scoring", "The build ratings use"), the site's rules page, Step 0 and every task page's score card read it from here, and tests/site/test_rating_build.py checks that the README states these values and that they are score/yosys_wasm.py's pins. The pinned FILES of the flow are hashed where they live (tests/expected.json `flow`, score/ppa_pins.json `liberty`, score/ppa.py itself); this file names the BUILD, which a golfer installs (`pip install -r requirements.txt`) and the repository cannot carry, and what was measured about it. Not part of what the checker hashes (score/yosys_wasm.py is). A change of the rating build is a decision of the maintainers: measure every stored number again under the new build first (`leaderboard.py remake --measure`).

yosys.build: YoWASP's WebAssembly build of Yosys 0.53 with ABC linked in, run by wasmtime

abc.version: the ABC of Yosys 0.53's release archive, linked into the module
abc.build: inside the module: there is no separate yosys-abc

determinism.what: every record of the board, from the same commit: the canonical RTLIL, the scored netlist, the netlists at the clocked records' other post-synthesis points and the A1' mapped netlists, 198 files, byte for byte equal, and every number

other_build.build: the native builds of the same Yosys 0.53 (Homebrew's for macOS arm64, clang++ and libc++; conda-forge's for x86-64 Linux, g++ and libstdc++)
other_build.cause: Yosys orders cells and connections by name indices it reuses in an order the C++ library sets, and ABC's mapper sorts cuts with the C library's qsort, which breaks ties its own way

previous.build: the Homebrew build of Yosys 0.53 for macOS arm64 (clang++ 17 with -O3) and its yosys-abc
previous.moved: three scores moved, all fdivp: its par -1.11%, tidereckon's Newton divider +1.11% and loamstep's D2 +3.00% (and their A1' columns); every other score and every board order stayed the same
